title: Summer Program for Undergraduates in Data Science (SPUDS)
institution: Harvard College and the Harvard Data Science Initiative
about: Residential ten-week summer research program in data science, co-sponsored by Harvard College and the Harvard Data Science Initiative, running early June to early August. Applications are due February 1, 2027 (Summer Funding Round B).
requirements: Undergraduate program; a confirmed research position is not needed by the deadline
Faculty research host must submit confirmation by March 1
